title: General Relativity (lecture notes)
institution: University of Cambridge, DAMTP (Part III Mathematical Tripos)
description: Masters-level (Part III) general relativity, written to be accessible without a prior GR course: 1 Geodesics in Spacetime; 2 Introducing Differential Geometry; 3 Introducing Riemannian Geometry; 4 The Einstein Equations; 5 When Gravity is Weak; 6 Black Holes. Four problem sheets and an HTML version.
rightsNotes: The notes page states no licence and no copyright or reuse terms. Author copyright is assumed; Corniversity treats the notes as reference-only (cite and link, do not copy or ingest).
The historic DAMTP address https://www.damtp.cam.ac.uk/user/tong/gr.html returned a 301 redirect to davidtong.org on 2026-10-30.
Convention: the introduction states 'We use the metric with signature (−+++)' (verified in the HTML version and in the Chapter 1 PDF), matching Corniversity's convention.
